tool_input.result: Implemented a complete workflow that triggers manually, uses AI completion to categorize a given news title, and sends the formatted message to Slack #general channel. The workflow was tested successfully with the news title 'Air Force pilot safely ejects before F-16 fighter jet crashes in California desert' and the category 'Military / Aviation' returned by AI. Slack message was sent correctly in the required format. All functions and workflow are working as expected with no errors.
